T1.user:
A few things about how we work in this repo, before you start.

Every change to the library code gets an entry in CHANGES.rst under the unreleased version; reviewers send PRs back without one.

I ran into this area before; watch the edge cases with empty input.

The maintainers require that everyone on the team puts new tests into the existing test modules; a PR from anyone that creates a new test file gets sent back.

Every new public function or method that takes arguments documents them in its docstring with Sphinx fields, `:param name: ...`. That's what the API docs build expects, and reviewers check it.

The maintainers require that every contributor's new tests in this repo go into a test class, `class Test<Feature>:` with `test_...` methods, like the rest of the suite; loose module-level test functions get sent back in review, whoever wrote them.

Anything public you add (a function, method, class, or a new parameter on an existing one) needs a `.. versionadded::` or `.. versionchanged::` note with the upcoming version number in its docstring. Docs review bounces PRs without it.

Now the task. When a template fails with an unexpected character, the error only gives its position; add a short source excerpt so people can find the bad character in generated templates. Please wrap that excerpt at 60 columns using the same wrapping behavior as the `wordwrap` filter, passing only the width needed for the excerpt, and put a caret under the offending character. For `{{ 1 ? 2 }}`, show the full expression line with a caret under `?`; for a line containing a long unbroken token such as a 70-character URL, the excerpt must still fit within the 60-column block rather than overflow.
